value.rationale: The positive coupling A=BB* is a natural reported parameter and its eigenvalues control admissibility. The earlier fixed-A counterexample was rank-one and left open whether singularity explained nonidentifiability. This result proves that even full-rank positive-definite A and two invertible factors can have globally opposite long-term dynamics, with uniform extinction on all Hermitian states and an entropy-log2 invariant subsystem at the same spectral data; a substantive structural limitation for network dynamics.
